/* CastDepMapper.retrieveDepFcltList */ SELECT SUBSTR(B.PSG_FCLT_CD, 4, 1) AS DPTGT_NO, B.PSG_FCLT_NM AS DPTGT_NM, B.USE_YN FROM PMOWN.TN_PM_SMLT_PSG_FCLT B WHERE 1 = 1 AND B.TMNL_ID = #{tmnlId}
AND B.UP_PSG_FCLT_CD IN ('LGT') ORDER BY DPTGT_NO

/* CastDepMapper.retrieveScCntList */ SELECT A.GATE_NO AS DPTGT_NO, A.FCLTY_CNT AS SCSH_CNTOM FROM PMOWN.TN_PM_SMLT_FCLTY_OPNG_SCRTY_CNTRL_ATRB A WHERE 1 = 1 AND A.SCRTY_CNTRL_ATRB_ID = REGEXP_REPLACE(#{scRsrcId}, 'FOTSC|FacilityOpeningTable_SecurityControl', '') AND A.TMNL_ID = #{tmnlId} ORDER BY DPTGT_NO

/* CastDepMapper.retrieveBaseLaneCntList */ SELECT A.GATE_NO AS DPTGT_NO, SUM(CASE WHEN A.FCLT_RCG = 'N' THEN A.FCLTY_CNT ELSE 0 END) AS GNRL_SRCH_CNTOM, SUM(CASE WHEN A.FCLT_RCG = 'Y' THEN A.FCLTY_CNT ELSE 0 END) AS SMART_PASS_SRCH_CNTOM FROM PMOWN.TN_PM_SMLT_FCLTY_OPNG_DPTGT_ATRB A WHERE 1 = 1 AND A.DPTGT_ATRB_ID = '001' AND A.OPER_BGNG_HM IS NULL AND A.TMNL_ID = #{tmnlId} GROUP BY A.GATE_NO ORDER BY DPTGT_NO
